page.overview:
What is Raw Porkchop?

A raw porkchop is a food item that can be eaten by the player or cooked to make a cooked porkchop.

Adult pigs drop 1–3 raw porkchop when killed. The maximum amount is increased by 1 per level of Looting, for a maximum of 1-6 with Looting III. If killed while on fire, they drop cooked porkchop instead.

Adult hoglins drop 2–4 raw porkchop when killed. The maximum amount is increased by 1 per level of Looting, for a maximum of 7 with Looting III. If killed while on fire, they drop cooked porkchop instead.

To eat raw porkchop, press and hold while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores hunger and 0.6 saturation.
